news.title: Regional grid operator warns of rolling outages after heat wave strains power plants
news.description: Officials said several fossil-fuel units tripped offline during record demand, forcing utilities to ration electricity across major cities for the second night. Consumer groups demanded transparency on maintenance schedules while industrial lobbies pressed for emergency fuel imports.
